description: Pick a file, preview it and upload it with progress. Picking needs `plux_media`; without it the control is disabled and PLX-5401 is reported. The upload is a transfer operation of a data source.

props.name: dataSource
props.description: The data source holding the upload operation.

props.name: operation
props.description: The upload operation of the data source.

props.name: accept
props.description: Accepted media types; any when empty.

events.name: onUploaded
events.description: Fires with the upload result when the upload succeeds.

events.name: onFailed
events.description: Fires with the error when picking or uploading fails.
